summary: Checks that the synthetic imagery change service labels demo cases correctly, reports insufficient evidence when no sample exists, uses fixed thresholds, and leaves other outputs unchanged.
purpose: Protects the behavior of the land-change indicator so future edits do not silently change its results.
why: Likely reason: the indicator must stay deterministic and must not make legal claims, so the tests pin its exact output.
how: Each test calls the service for a demo case, compares the result with fixed expected values, and checks that related outputs (parcel intelligence and verification) stay the same.
inputs: Demo case identifiers and fixed thresholds.
risks: Expected values are hard-coded, so a deliberate policy change requires updating several checks.
debug: If a test fails, compare the actual value with the expected one, then check the synthetic imagery provider data and the threshold settings.
